transcript: If you keep waking up in the middle of the night, it's not because you need the bathroom, and it's not because of a dream, it's your soul asking you to listen. In ancient Chinese medicine, there is a time called liver hour, and it falls exactly between 1 am and 3 am. This is the time when the liver processes toxins, not only physical ones, but emotional ones as well. Old anger, unspoken fear, disappointment you haven't allowed yourself to feel, thoughts you push away during the day, at night they rise. The night is when the body speaks softly. When you wake up at this hour, it's a sign that your inner world is trying to release something you are still holding on to. It is not a malfunction, it is communication. Before you fall back asleep, close your eyes, place your hand on your chest and ask, what is my heart trying to tell me that I'm afraid to hear during the day? Let your breath soften the body. Let the emotion rise without judgement. Sometimes, listening alone is the beginning of healing.
